where: Pale Vault Glacier (the aurora-lit ice town outdoors); returns after meeting Warden Còr and after the Aurora-watch vigil
mood: Aurora Vault — glacial, shimmering, lonely-beautiful; the stillest, most tender place in the north, suspended and never quite resolving.
core_styles: suspended C major, sus2 and sus4 chords
slow glassy chime lead melody with long notes and space between
widely spaced crystal arpeggio drifting upward like cold light
very slow sustained low bass pedal
soft wide cymbal swell like an aurora swoosh every four bars instead of a beat
lonely, still, glacial, beautiful ice field under the aurora at night

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a quiet glittering entrance: a single soft aurora cymbal swell rises over a low pedal, a few crystal chimes fall like ice dust, opening onto stillness}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the slow glassy melody: a rising lift held long over two bars, then a gentle descent that hangs on the second degree, softly open; arpeggio drifting high, bass barely moving}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again, a soft string pad blooming under it and a second chime voice echoing each phrase an octave up, still unresolved}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: A minor and F major, the only warmth, a tender lower line like breath in the cold, swelling once with the aurora}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the glassy theme returns, sparser and still; the last bar holds a suspended D colour that rises straight back into the theme}
